Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Patients with uni- [OR]  or bipolar depression, diagnosed according to the criteria of the DSM-IV via MINI 6

-  At the time of inclusion in the study, the symptoms must meet at least the requirements of a moderately severe depression, defined by a minimum score of ≥ 22 on the Montgomery-Åsberg Depression Scale

Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Patients with severe somatic, [OR]  rheumatic, [OR]  endocrine  [OR] or neurological comorbidities

right.raw_text: This includes in particular neurological disorders associated with cognitive disorder, severe liver, [OR]  kidney  [OR] and cardiac diseases

left.raw_text: -  Patients, who are being treated permanently with anti-inflammatory  [OR] or immunosuppressive drugs (e

right.raw_text: corticosteroids or alpha  [OR] / beta-a(nta)gonists, [OR]  immuno suppressant drugs)

left.raw_text: -  Patients with severe psychiatric disorders (Axis I) such as schizophrenia, [OR]  dementia, [OR]  ADHD, [OR]  obsessive-compulsive disorder, current alcohol, [OR]  drugs  [OR] or drug addiction
-  Patients who have already been treated unsuccessfully with sertraline  [OR] and all alternate medications allowed in the study
